name: Crop Cycle Gap Fill
description: New plants added to beds that are still standing -- topping up dead or missing spots (a gap), not a fresh planting on cleared ground (that's a Replant).

fields.label: Bed Range
fields.description: Which beds got new plants, e.g. 12-18

fields.label: Applied
fields.description: Set once this row's plants have been added to the bed(s). Never re-applied after that, or every future save would add them again.
